source_semantics.review: Individually review all eight complete files and 42 hunks. The runtime change injects ChangeDetectorRef into CdkContextMenuTrigger and marks after imperative open; it is not a test-only commit. The add-on neither imports nor forks CDK menu. Its independently owned Material-16 trigger keeps its historical click, overlay and focus lifecycle. Seven specs remove zone providers and add explicit marks; the modern Material menu additionally changes the recursive-menu throw into console-error observation and flushes the lazy-trigger case. Do not adopt that weakened error observation or switch the historical zoneful runner merely to follow this fixture migration. All 223 cases retain identity; 204 complete callbacks are unchanged. Whole-file finite projection proves all operations in the six CDK specs unchanged beyond exact imports/provider/mark roles; the modern menu error, helper provider and flush frames are individually retained. The owned recursive-menu regression still asserts a throw, the runner still explicitly provides zone change detection, and its public whenStable method is no longer overridden. No owned HTML, CSS, SCSS or conservative TS API change is needed. Public CDK menu source at both floors is recorded only as context, not as an executed legacy path.
